title: Pepe, der Paukerschreck - Die Lümmel von der ersten Bank, III. Teil
actors: Hans Kraus, Uschi Glas, Hannelore Elsner
plot: Giessen's gymnasium director Gottlieb Taft hopes a ploy will make the school's centennial a prank-free success: he enrolls his nerdy nephew Ewalt Kunst as spy in Pepe's dreaded class. Some of Pepe's tricks are thus undone, others ...
